ModuleName: Building a Standards Library and Mapping Topics to Standards

Artifacts.Name: Module Topics
Artifacts.Description: A structured outline of the module listing all topics and subtopics covered, used by instructors and designers to understand the scope and sequence of the module at a glance.

Artifacts.Name: What Is the Standards Library
Artifacts.Description: An introductory lesson explaining what the Standards Library is, why it exists in PreseMaker, and how it solves the problem of managing large standards frameworks during course design.

Artifacts.Name: Building the Library with AI
Artifacts.Description: A lesson explaining how to use PreseMaker's AI to automatically extract and organize standards from a framework, covering what input to provide, how the AI processes it, and how to review the results.

Artifacts.Name: Understanding the Verified and Unverified Markers
Artifacts.Description: A lesson clarifying what the Verified and Unverified markers on library standards actually mean in PreseMaker, correcting common misconceptions and explaining the practical implications of each marker for course alignment.

Artifacts.Name: Cognitive Levels on Standards
Artifacts.Description: A lesson covering how Bloom's Taxonomy cognitive levels apply to standards in PreseMaker, explaining why matching the cognitive demand of a standard matters when designing topics and learning outcomes.

Artifacts.Name: Mapping Topics and Learning Outcomes to Standards
Artifacts.Description: A lesson explaining how to create explicit, documented connections between course topics, learning outcomes, and specific standards in PreseMaker, guiding instructors through the mapping process.
